crossRefs.note: “ ‘You shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in measures of length, of weight, or of quantity.
You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of…
A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.
Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.
Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
“You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath.
The ephah and the bath shall be of one measure, that the bath may contain one tenth of a homer, and the ephah one tenth…
Saying, ‘When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell grain? And the Sabbath, that we may market wheat, making the…
Shall I be pure with dishonest scales, and with a bag of deceitful weights?
Her rich men are full of violence, her inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their speech.

translations.web: You shall not have in your bag diverse weights, one heavy and one light.
translations.bsb: You shall not have two differing weights in your bag, one heavy and one light.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt not have in thy bag divers weights, a great and a small.
translations.asv: Thou shalt not have in thy bag diverse weights, a great and a small.
